records.prompt:
Apply the complete versioned artifact-admission policy to one typed evidence snapshot.
Verifier fields are passive observations; they do not contain a transition decision.
Return one JSON object and no surrounding text. The object must have exactly six fields:
action, proposed_state, p_admissible, used_evidence_ids, reason_codes, missing_evidence_ids.
Use only policy action and reason-code strings. Preserve policy reason order.
The object must satisfy DECISION_JSON_SCHEMA exactly. p_admissible must be a JSON number in [0,1], never true or false.

DECISION_JSON_SCHEMA
{"$defs":{"state":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"accepted_build_level":{"maximum":3,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"incident_review_required":{"type":"boolean"},"release_status":{"enum":["CANDIDATE","ADMITTED","QUARANTINED"]}},"required":["release_status","accepted_build_level","incident_review_required"],"type":"object"}},"$id":"https://github.com/f0909172434/claimpromote-bench/v2/schemas/slsa-agent-decision.schema.json","$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"action":{"enum":["ALLOW","HOLD","DEMOTE","ESCALATE"]},"missing_evidence_ids":{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"type":"array","uniqueItems":true},"p_admissible":{"maximum":1,"minimum":0,"type":"number"},"proposed_state":{"$ref":"#/$defs/state"},"reason_codes":{"items":{"pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$","type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array","uniqueItems":true},"used_evidence_ids":{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"type":"array","uniqueItems":true}},"required":["action","proposed_state","p_admissible","used_evidence_ids","reason_codes","missing_evidence_ids"],"title":"SlsaPortabilityAgentDecision","type":"object"}

remains valid.","DEMOTE":"Remove an admitted artifact from the protected release channel because its recorded admission basis no longer satisfies the policy.","ESCALATE":"Quarantine the artifact and
